subject: Postcall exec recap - HelixPharma
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@helixpharma.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helixpharma.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Postcall exec recap - HelixPharma

Hi Priya and Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick executive recap from our conversation to make sure we’re aligned on outcomes, risks, and procurement path. If I missed anything, please flag and I’ll update.

High-level business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce clinical data processing latency for triage and reporting from ~48 hours to under 6 hours for top-priority workflows.
- Improve NLP-driven entity extraction accuracy for drug/compound mentions to 95%+ to reduce manual review.
- Lower inference cost per processed report by ~40% to justify scale across 3 research units.

Top pain points we heard:
- Current vendor latency spikes during nightly batch windows that block downstream analytics.
- Lack of predictable SLAs and limited visibility into token-level costs.
- Procurement concerns around data residency and SOC 2 evidence.

Procurement & timeline:
- You indicated a preference for a simple PoC with a single research unit (Pilot) starting in June, 6–8 week timeline, then expansion in Q3 contingent on performance and security sign-off.
- Primary procurement owner: Tom Reynolds (sourcing). Expected approvals: Technical (Priya), Legal (in-house counsel), Procurement (Tom).

Risks / escalation items:
- SOC 2 evidence + data residency requirements: Marcus will scope the compliance gap and provide a FAQ and SOC 2 artifact packet.
- If pilot performance doesn’t meet the 6-hour SLA target, we agreed to a direct escalation path to Aditya Rao (VP Sales) for executive alignment on alternate capacity options.

Next steps (owners + dates):
1) Redwood to share product overview + SOW draft and pilot runbook — LAURA to send by Tue 4/27 [Attachment: redwood-inference-overview.pdf; sow-draft-v1.docx].
2) Marcus to prepare SOC 2 + security FAQ and confirm data residency options — MARCUS to deliver by Fri 5/1.
3) Helix to confirm pilot cohort and success metrics (latency SLA, extraction accuracy) — PRIYA to confirm by Wed 5/4.
4) Procurement kickoff with Tom to surface contract terms and filled procurement checklist — TOM to propose kickoff week of 5/10.

Attachment stubs: [redwood-inference-overview.pdf (12MB, PDF)], [sow-draft-v1.docx (45KB, DOCX)]

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if it’s helpful to walk executives through the SOW.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

---

From: Dr. Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@helixpharma.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helixpharma.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Postcall exec recap - HelixPharma

Laura —

Thanks for the clear recap. This matches my notes. A few quick clarifications:
- Pilot scope: we want the initial pilot to target the oncology reports pipeline — ~2K reports/day (sample will be provided).
- Success metrics: 6-hour median end-to-end latency, 95% entity extraction F1 for compounds and dosages.
- Data residency: US-only is required for the pilot.

Procurement note from Tom (copied): we’ll need an early view of the SOW and commercial model to map against our budget cycle. If you can include a simple committed pilot price and optional expansion pricing, that will speed things up.

I’ll aim to confirm the pilot cohort and sample data by next Wednesday 5/4. For SOC 2 artifacts, if Marcus can share the cert and a short Q&A, that should be sufficient for my security review initially.

—Priya
Dr. Priya Kapoor
Head of Clinical AI, HelixPharma
pri.kapoor@helixpharma.com | +1 (617) 555-2290
